name: bolt-sort
description: Bolt Sort: a calm color-sort puzzle for Android and iOS (TypeScript + Phaser 3 + Capacitor)

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/services && tsc -p packages/game && tsc -p tools/level-gen
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build && npm run sync -w @bolt-sort/mobile
scripts.android: npm run mobile:sync && npm run open:android -w @bolt-sort/mobile
scripts.ios: npm run mobile:sync && npm run open:ios -w @bolt-sort/mobile
